Since 0.1.6. The major version stays 0.

### Screens
Settings › System › Layout chooses how the Thor's two screens are used: Art top (the default), Art bottom, or Top only (#344). Top only keeps Home on the top screen and leaves the bottom screen dark. Play on chooses which screen A opens a one-screen game on. X uses the other one.

When a game launches, its art grows to fill both screens, and when you come back Home lands on the game you just played (#343). DroidDeck now opens on the top screen and takes both screens, as PXPlay and 3DS games do (#359).

### Play
Settings › Emulators › Systems chooses the emulator for each system. Automatic keeps today's pick. Y › Open with sets one game's emulator (#347).

A game left paused can be closed from Home, along with the apps Foldcade opened beside it. DuckStation games can move to the other screen while they run (#342).

RomM shows when saves are waiting, and you can connect it by scanning a QR code with your phone (#352). Saved RomM games show while the catalog refreshes (#356).

### Games
Game art and info now come from your own ES-DE, Batocera and Skraper media, and from RomM's summaries (#345). The top screen shows the year and genre. Rest on a game for its summary, press R3 to open it, or open Y › About.

Y's menu now opens beside the tile it's for (#348, #350).

Y › Play time moves play time to another game, so a renamed ROM keeps its history. Play history can be exported and imported (#341).

### Backup
Settings › System › Backup saves your Foldcade setup to one file, and restores it after a reinstall or on a new device (#346).

### Speed
Foldcade starts faster, scrolls more smoothly and frees memory while a game plays (#340, #353, #354, #355, #357, #358).

### Fixes
Pages go back to their screen, a paused ROM's play time stays accurate, and Home is back on top after a restore (#349). Labels, hints and pages from the 2 November Thor QA are cleaned up (#351). Builds made on a dev machine get their own icon and label (#339).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
